messages:
devin: Quick heads-up — seeing a regression on the v3 causal path when head_dim % 16 != 0 (example: 30). Kernel picker picks flash_v3 but we end up in an SDPA slow fallback because of KV-cache alignment + stride issues. Repro attached.

anna: Can you paste the perf numbers and the kernel decision trace? :eyes:

devin: p50 tokens/sec (SM80, 8xA100-ish): v2_flash: 1200 t/s, v3_flash (chosen): 980 t/s (– 18%). Trace: select=flash_v3 -> probe(sizes)-> probe_alignment -> fallback=sdpa_slow_path. KV cache hit rate drops ~20% on fallback.

sam: I think autotuner head-rounding is the culprit. Our picker quantizes head_dim to 32 for v3 on newer archs; SM80's loads prefer 16 or even 8 for small seqlen. Suggest: reduce head_round granularity for seq_len <= 64. Example tweak: 
```
# autotuner snippet
kernel_picker:
  flash_v3:
    head_round: if seq_len <= 64 then 8 else 16
    preferred_arch: [sm86, sm80]
    forbid_if_kv_layout == interleaved
```
This forces the picker to avoid flash_v3 for odd head sizes when packing is interleaved.

matt: Another angle: microbatching + KV-packing interacts badly. flash_v3 assumes per-head contiguous KV (head-major); our packer sometimes interleaves heads to optimize gpu memory for odd head counts -> misaligned loads/smaller vector widths -> slower. We should detect `kv_layout=interleaved` and bias toward v2 or the sdpa_blocked kernel.

devin: Repro script: `scripts/repro/head30_causal.sh` uses MODEL=redwood-mini SEQLEN=64 HEAD_DIM=30 BATCH=4. Running with sam's head_round tweak now. Will post numbers.

bench-bot: Bench link (staging): https://bench.example/1767890123 — after applying head_round=8 + kv_layout check: p50 improved +15% vs tuned baseline.

anna: Can we add a fast rollback rule? If a kernel selection results in fallback to slow_path and token latency increases >10% compared to last stable, revert to v2_flash automatically for that model/version/seq_len. That'll reduce blast radius while we iterate.

sam: Agreed. Quick conditional rule: 
```
rollouts:
  kernel_picker_guardrail:
    trigger: fallback_latency_regression > 0.10
    action: pin_kernel: v2_flash
    scope: model+version+seq_len
```
I'll open a PR with unit tests for head_dim edgecases + a small microbenchmark to catch regressions early.

devin: Thanks — I'll open the picker PR to add kv_layout check and the head_round change, add the repro as an integration test. Will include notes for ops to run rollback rule if needed. :thumbsup:
